summary: Updated goal resume flow to auto-retry execution blocks with requiredInputKey="none" and added a final-build-gate escape hatch so runs with no resumable steps but failed final gate fall through to executeGoalWithAgent after clearing blocked state. Added goal-resume tests covering (1) none-key resume without /goal_answer and (2) failed final gate retry path invoking executor instead of short-circuiting. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/commands/goal-resume.test.ts, pnpm build, and pnpm lint.
